name: SU Context Checking
description: Checks /proc/self/attr/current and per-process SELinux contexts for root-related anomalies.

evidenceUnits.title: Process SELinux context anomaly
evidenceUnits.observedObject: SELinux contexts exposed for the current and visible processes
evidenceUnits.proposition: A visible process context matches a root-related or otherwise abnormal context rule
evidenceUnits.availability: Depends on procfs visibility and permission to read process attributes
evidenceUnits.trustBoundary: The process-visible procfs and SELinux views may be mediated
evidenceUnits.inferenceLimit: A context match is an indicator and does not prove that this application can obtain root
